note: Each entry is an arrangement of 18 straight lines forming 93 non-overlapping triangles, given as exact rational coefficients (a, b, c) for a*x + b*y = c. Fields triple_points and parallel_pairs declare the degeneracies of that arrangement; both empty means the arrangement is simple. All arrangements here are pairwise non-isomorphic (line relabeling and per-line order reflection), non-isomorphic to those in the sol*/ folders, and non-isomorphic to Bader's published 93.
